# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt
Create a durable decision note for a structural source/export boundary that changed after review.

## Expected selection
use

## Why
The task has a new durable choice that future agents need to find.

## Expected object
A source-owned decision record creation route with local index rebuild and graph refresh.

## Boundary notes
This is an aoa-decision-create case because the source decision note does not exist yet.

## Verification hooks
- check graph issues before writing
- write the repo-local source note
- rebuild local indexes and refresh or check the workspace graph
